decision_basis.required_question: does unchanged label-invariant Layer B add heldout predictive value to the same strong conventional learner on a genuinely fresh endpoint?

architecture_boundary.layer_a: retain exact world identity, sequential compatibility filtering, contraction, provenance, and falsification
architecture_boundary.layer_b: retain unchanged symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 as a candidate predictive complement to strong conventional learners

allowed_claim: On the first genuinely fresh post-Daphnia paired endpoint, the unchanged label-invariant Layer B supplied non-redundant heldout predictive information beyond the same strong conventional random forest.
prohibited_claims: standalone predictive sufficiency of Layer B
truth identification of an exact Layer A world
production/API readiness from one favorable fresh endpoint

preferred_heterogeneity: island or strongly isolated assembly/dispersal dynamics
a second non-telemetry observation process such as camera, survey, or repeated occurrence data
